value.rationale: Answers the motivating paper’s concrete open-ended question with a complete three-way classification over every finite vocabulary, not a single example. Supplies uniform depth-one normal forms using only classical antecedents and bottom consequents, separates the third conditional at every depth, and gives an exact strict depth boundary. These statements can transfer known results about union-closed team properties to natural new conditional languages.
